name: Parkview Haven Nursing Home
priceNote: Nebraska average for a nursing home (semi-private to private room). This facility does not publish its price.

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Reasonably accommodate the needs and preferences of each resident
inspections.detail: Reasonably accommodate the needs and preferences of each resident.

inspections.title: Abuse allegation not investigated properly
inspections.detail: Respond appropriately to all alleged violations.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Bed rails used without safety checks
inspections.detail: Try different approaches before using a bed rail.  If a bed rail is needed, the facility must (1) assess a resident for safety risk; (2) review these risks and benefits with the resident/representative; (3) get informed consent; and (4) Correctly install and maintain the bed rail.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Poor ventilation
inspections.detail: Have enough outside ventilation via a window or mechanical ventilation, or both.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Resident assessment inaccurate
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.

inspections.title: Not reassessed after a major change
inspections.detail: Assess the resident when there is a significant change in condition

quality.label: Needing more help with daily activities

openings.note: Estimate: certified beds minus average daily residents (CMS). Certified beds are often more than the beds actually staffed. Call to confirm.

bio: Government nursing home in Deshler with 49 certified beds. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab.
